# Task Launch Policy

An abstract Connected Clause marker for clauses that invoke the package-owned Work request function.

`parameters.workClause` is the Work-clause reference and defaults to `work`. `bindingTypes` is empty: this marker declares no property bindings. It also declares no named launch actions.

Inherited Connected Clause behavior turns named action connections into native channels and workflows. Actions and executable hooks come from the admitted exact clause type; bindings configure declared actions. Changing an installed clause's configuration requires a new clause key.

This marker does not specify concrete launch triggers, actors, request arguments or Work acceptance and rejection rules. It establishes no task-progress state. A Work request represents a request for work, not confirmation that a task has started or completed.
